proc_p: Upholstered pieces are made to order once you’ve chosen your design and fabric.
steps: We measure the bed and wall and bring fabric samples so you can see them in your own room.
We agree the shape, size and fabric with you, and the quote lists everything included.
Each headboard or piece is made to your measurements in the fabric you chose.
We fit it in place, covered by our 12-month guarantee.
book_p: Book a visit and we’ll bring fabric samples to your home, measure up and send you a clear quote.
